text:
5 days ago Looking to refresh your home or take on a DIY project? There are some great free items available right now around Plymouth, MI — from furniture to vintage lighting and building materials.
Pair of Vintage Ceiling Light Fixtures These white glass globes with floral designs sit on brass bases . They’re fully functional, though there’s some paint on the base that can be scraped off. Perfect for a retro or classic look in your home.
Location: Beacon Trail, Plymouth, MI Source: Nextdoor
👉 See this item on Nextdoor 4 Cabinet Doors + Large Lot of White MDF + Hardware A treasure trove for DIYers! This lot includes four glass doors (46"H x 15.5"W each) and two large boxes of 5/8” thick MDF wood parts — perfect for building cabinets, shelving, or other creative projects.
Location: W Ann Arbor Trail, Plymouth, MI Source: Nextdoor
👉 See this item on Nextdoor Free Sofa A used sofa in fair condition is available for free. You’ll need to pick it up yourself, but it could be a great find for a spare room or starter apartment.
Location: Plymouth, MI Source: Facebook Marketplace
👉 See this item on Facebook Marketplace Free items like these tend to go fast, so if something catches your eye, reach out to the poster soon!
Please note: Availability changes quickly. Some items listed here may have already been claimed, and links may no longer be active. Contact the poster directly for the most up-to-date information.
